account.signup.label: New user registration
account.signup.description: A new user account was registered.
account.signup.personal_data: The new member's email address and name.

notify.body_template: A new account was registered with email {email}.

newsletter.signup.label: Newsletter signup
newsletter.signup.description: Someone subscribed to a mailing list / newsletter.
newsletter.signup.personal_data: Which member joined which mailing list.

notify.body_template: A user subscribed to the "{mailing_list_name}" mailing list.

content.reported.label: Content reported
content.reported.description: A member reported someone else's content (a forum post, a chat message) for an admin to look at.

payload.entity_type: Reported content type (the handler's type, e.g. forum_post)
payload.content_label: What the content is, e.g. Forum post
payload.content_title: The content's title in the queue

comment.posted.label: New comment posted
comment.posted.description: A new comment was posted on a blog post.
comment.posted.personal_data: The commenter's name and the start of the comment.

payload.comment_excerpt: Comment body excerpt (truncated at the call site)

secret.unreadable.label: Sealed secret unreadable
secret.unreadable.description: A stored secret (a credential, token, or signing key) cannot be decrypted with this install's key — most often because the database was moved to a machine without the matching secret_box_key, or the key was rotated. Raised once when a secret goes dead, not on every reconcile.

payload.label: Human name of the affected secret (or a batch summary)
payload.count: How many secrets this alert covers
payload.link: Admin surface to act on it

notify.body_template: {feature}: a stored secret cannot be decrypted here. Re-enter it, or acknowledge a re-mint, on the secrets health page.

site.outbound_transfer_high.label: This server sent more than its monthly figure
site.outbound_transfer_high.description: What this server has sent this month passed the figure its owner set (outbound_monthly_notice_gb). Most providers bill outbound transfer past an allowance. Raised once a month, the first time the count passes the figure; never on a site the operator hosts on its own account.

payload.sent: What the server has sent this month, in words
payload.detail: The whole sentence: how much, and where to check the allowance

notify.title_template: This server has sent {sent} this month

post.published.label: Blog post published
post.published.description: A blog post was published: saved with a publish time for the first time, or published again after being taken down.

payload.source_user_id: Acting user id (who published it), when a person did

account.updated.label: Member profile changed
account.updated.description: A member's name, nickname, organization, email address or time zone changed, by the member, an admin or an email-change confirmation.
account.updated.personal_data: The member's email address and name, and which profile fields changed.

payload.changed: The fields that changed, comma-separated: first_name, last_name, nickname, organization_name, email, timezone
payload.source_user_id: Acting user id, when a person did

message.received.label: New message
message.received.description: A message was added to a conversation (Messages). Never what it says; for a private conversation not who wrote it or where either, only that it arrived.
message.received.personal_data: Who wrote to whom in a standard conversation (never the text).

payload.conversation_id: Conversation id (empty for a private conversation)
payload.sender_user_id: Sender user id (empty for a private conversation, or a message from another site)
payload.recipient_count: How many other members of the conversation it reached
payload.protection: The conversation's protection level: standard or private
payload.source_user_id: Acting user id (the sender; empty as sender_user_id is)

file.uploaded.label: Public file uploaded
file.uploaded.description: A person uploaded a file anyone may see (no privacy, permission, group or tier restriction): a library file, a photo, an image in a post.
file.uploaded.personal_data: Who uploaded the file, and its name.

payload.file_title: The name it was uploaded with
payload.source: What it was uploaded for (the file's origin tag), when it says
